camel_example: aliyun dataworks-public CreateCustomAttribute --region cn-hangzhou --EntityTypes 'maxcompute-table' --Type TEXT --DisplayName '业务负责人' --Id 'custom-attribute:biz_owner'
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public create-custom-attribute --id custom-attribute:biz_owner --display-name '业务负责人' --type TEXT --entity-types maxcompute-table --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCustomAttribute

parameters.help_en: The custom attribute ID. The value must match `^custom-attribute:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,98}$`. The part after custom-attribute: must be less than 100 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 自定义属性ID，需匹配 `^custom-attribute:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,98}$`，custom-attribute: 后面的部分长度小于100
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The display name of the custom attribute. The value must be less than 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 自定义属性展示名称，长度小于128个字符
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en: The type of the custom attribute. Valid values: ENUM, TEXT, and HYPERLINK
parameters.help_zh: 自定义属性类型，支持 ENUM、TEXT、HYPERLINK
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The list of applicable entity types. Exact entity types and wildcard patterns such as `*-table` and `*-column` are supported. Examples:
dataworks-project: workspace
dataworks-dataset: DataWorks dataset
maxcompute-table: MaxCompute table
*-column: all column types
parameters.help_zh:
适用实体类型列表，支持精确实体类型以及 `*-table`、`*-column` 通配写法，如
dataworks-project 工作空间
dataworks-dataset dataworks数据集
maxcompute-table maxcompute表
*-column 所有字段类型
parameters.name: entity_types

parameters.help_en: The enumeration values. This parameter is required when type is set to ENUM. This parameter is not supported for TEXT or HYPERLINK types
parameters.help_zh: 枚举可选值，type=ENUM时必填；TEXT、HYPERLINK类型不支持
parameters.name: value_enums

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to display the attribute on the details page. Default value: true
parameters.help_zh: 是否在详情页展示，默认为true
parameters.name: display_enabled

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the attribute can be used as a filter condition on the DataWorks Data Map search page. Default value: false. Currently, only the ENUM type supports setting this value to true
parameters.help_zh: 是否支持在数据地图搜索页作为筛选条件，默认为false，目前仅ENUM类型配置该值为true
parameters.name: search_filter_enabled

parameters.help_en: The description of the custom attribute. The value must be less than 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 自定义属性描述，长度小于256个字符
parameters.name: comment

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
